name: eventblast-monorepo
description: WhatsApp Event Marketing Platform - Production-Ready Multi-Tenant SaaS

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=packages/types run build && npm --workspace=packages/shared run build && npm --workspace=packages/validation run build && npm --workspace=packages/whatsapp run build && npm --workspace=packages/database run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --workspace=apps/api run build && npm --workspace=apps/worker run build && npm --workspace=apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:api
scripts.test:packages: npm --workspace=packages/shared run test && npm --workspace=packages/whatsapp run test

author: EventBlast Team
